meta.scoring: wis: weighted interval score with 50/80/95% intervals and the median (a proper score that approaches CRPS); quantiles of each origin estimated on the other origins
meta.method: Targets are protests and riots (ACLED), with the same features as the violence model. one LightGBM model for all six horizons, trained with absolute error on the log ratio to the 6-period average, blended with the 6-period average and the last period (weights fitted on past backtest origins); provinces scaled to the country total; scaled-residual intervals from a rolling backtest
